data.title: Perk Brings Its Award-Winning Spend Platform to the US, Already One of the Company's Fastest-Growing Markets
data.description: The AI-native platform for travel and spend management, Perk, has launched its fintech product Perk Spend in the United States. The country currently sees customers spending over $1 billion annually on work travel and team events. This expansion signifies Perk’s goal to serve as the go-to solution for diverse global teams' evolving travel and spending requirements. The introduction of Perk Spend in the US comes after its successful debut in Europe, where it has already secured up to 40% of new deals.

data.description: The collaboration between Array and Tyfone has resulted in the incorporation of Array's entire product lineup into Tyfone's digital banking service. The partnership aims to provide enhanced services to customers, with these advancements being rolled out in New York on September 15, 2026. data.title: AI Investment Is Outpacing Organizations' Ability to Realize Value, New HTEC Research Finds

data.title: The More Life Company Reports Positive Third-Party Agrarius Potato Trial Results in Brazil
data.description: The More Life Company Corp. (TMLC) announced successful results from an independent field trial assessing their Agrarius™ agricultural plant signaling technology in Brazil. The trial was conducted independently and demonstrated the effectiveness of TMLC's licensed technology.

data.title: Eon, CancerIQ Partner to Find At-Risk Patients Earlier and Drive Completion of Recommended Care
data.description: A recent collaboration between health systems now offers two avenues of access to a shared standard. data.title: Agiloft Research Reveals Hidden Procurement Value Gap: 52% of Enterprises Miss Contractual Remedies as Supplier Spend Flows Off-Contract
data.description: An analysis reveals that 82% of procurement teams currently have responsibility for managing contracts. Surprisingly, over 50% of these teams have failed to utilize contractual remedies within the last year. Additionally, it has been identified that a minimum of 15% of supplier expenditure occurs outside of the agreed-upon contracts. This report comes out just before Agiloft is set to showcase at the 2026 Gartner® event.
